'''Jim Haskell''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Gold 89 from Woodbridge, Va. The slot was marked Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.<ref name="sm-fan" />

Listed as James Haskell, he learned the game from his son in November 1996. He became a tournament director in April 1998 and joined Gold Squadron in September 1998 on [[Ryan Werntz]]'s suggestion.<ref name="decsq-prof" />
